name: Ardon
overview: Ardon was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Cheubai, who is also known as Caleb. His mention is brief and focused on his genealogical position within the tribe. There are no additional notes or details about his life or role beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Ardon is a proper name meaning "hunchbacked." This meaning is noted but was not given directly by God. The name itself does not carry explicit theological significance beyond its literal translation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Ardon as the son of Azubah, establishing a direct familial link. Beyond this, no other family relationships are detailed in the biblical text concerning Ardon.
scriptureSignificance: Ardon's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of Judah, linking him to the line of Caleb. This genealogy affirms the continuity of God's covenant people through the tribe of Judah. Though not a prominent figure in narrative events, his mention preserves the heritage and lineage important for understanding the biblical history of Israel.
